Select IC50 activity rows for human fatty acid amide hydrolase 1. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays to target_dictionary. Join compound_records on activities.record_id and docs on compound_records.doc_id. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN. Filter by target name 'fatty acid amide hydrolase 1' and target organism 'Homo sapiens' and standard_type 'IC50'. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
